title: Surface water
summary: Explore the parameters of rivers, lakes and water sources.
bodyHtml: Surface water monitoring provides information about water conditions and changes over time. Explore instruments for dissolved oxygen, turbidity, algae and other available parameters according to your monitoring location.

products.name: IG3000 Display Multichannel Controller
products.shortDescription: Bring compatible digital and analog water sensors together in a multichannel controller with a clear display and menu navigation. Configurable outputs, relays and communication options support process integration, while an output-hold function assists with sensor maintenance.

products.name: IG30PHS Digital pH Electrode
products.shortDescription: Digital pH measurement combines a gel-filled electrode, double-junction reference and integrated temperature sensing. Modbus communication supports connection to compatible controllers, while calibration options and the supplied mounting bracket and flow cell support installation and routine operation.

products.name: IG30RDO Optical Dissolved Oxygen Sensor
products.shortDescription: Fluorescence-based sensing measures dissolved oxygen without electrolyte replacement or sensor polarization. Integrated temperature compensation and digital communication support continuous water monitoring, with air and sample calibration options for use in treatment, environmental and aquaculture applications.

products.name: IG30SS/SOL Suspended Solids and Sludge Concentration Sensor
products.shortDescription: Infrared scattered-light sensing monitors suspended solids and sludge concentration in water and wastewater processes. The digital probe combines optical compensation with a sapphire window, while an optional cleaning brush helps manage deposits during continuous monitoring at the measurement point.

products.name: IG30UVNO3 UV Nitrate Nitrogen Sensor
products.shortDescription: Ultraviolet absorption measures nitrate nitrogen directly in water without chemical reagents or a separate sampling system. Selectable optical paths, interference compensation and automatic cleaning support online deployment in drinking water, environmental monitoring and wastewater treatment applications.

products.name: IG3000MP-X Multiparameter Water Analyzer
products.shortDescription: Build a water monitoring system around interchangeable digital probes for parameters such as pH, dissolved oxygen, conductivity and turbidity. Probe connections and stored calibration data support field replacement, while an automatic cleaning arrangement helps limit surface deposits.

products.name: IG30CDS Conductivity Sensor
products.shortDescription: Measure conductivity in water treatment and industrial process water with a choice of cell constants. Digital communication and stored calibration settings support system integration and routine operation, while the supplied mounting arrangement and flow cell simplify installation.

products.name: IG30CLS Residual Chlorine Sensor
products.shortDescription: Using a constant-potential electrochemical method, this sensor measures residual chlorine and chlorine dioxide in water. A dedicated flow cell maintains sample flow, while the design avoids colorimetric reagents and routine replacement of membranes or electrolyte.

products.name: IG30CODM Colored Dissolved Organic Matter Sensor
products.shortDescription: Ultraviolet fluorescence measures colored dissolved organic matter directly in water. A compact probe, automatic cleaning brush and digital communication support continuous online monitoring in rivers, lakes, groundwater and wastewater, with deployment tailored to the monitoring location.

products.name: IG30HT High-Range Turbidity Sensor
products.shortDescription: Infrared scattered-light sensing measures turbidity in process water, surface water and treatment applications. The digital probe combines optical compensation with a sapphire window and offers an optional cleaning brush to reduce deposits during ongoing monitoring.

products.name: IG30ISE-X Ion-Selective Electrode
products.shortDescription: Ion-selective measurement supports water monitoring for configured ion parameters and pH. The immersion probe operates without a separate sampling system and provides compensation and calibration functions, making it suitable for drinking water, environmental and wastewater applications.

products.name: IG30PH01 Analog pH Electrode
products.shortDescription: An analog pH electrode for water and process monitoring, combining a gel-filled design with a double-junction reference arrangement. An integrated temperature sensor supports compensation, and the mounting bracket and flow cell provide options for installation at the measurement point.

products.name: IG30PTCO Water Color Sensor
products.shortDescription: Optical absorption measures water color against the platinum-cobalt color scale. Automatic turbidity compensation and a cleaning brush support online monitoring, while stored calibration settings and digital communication simplify connection to water monitoring systems at the installation site.

products.name: IG30RPS Digital ORP Electrode
products.shortDescription: A digital ORP electrode for oxidation-reduction monitoring in water and industrial processes. Its platinum sensing element and double-junction reference are complemented by digital communication, sample or standard calibration, and a mounting bracket and flow cell for installation.

products.name: IG30RPS01 Analog ORP Electrode
products.shortDescription: An analog ORP electrode for water treatment and process monitoring, using a platinum sensing element and double-junction reference. Sample and standard calibration options, together with a mounting bracket and flow cell, support installation and routine measurement.

products.name: IG30TPY Water Transparency Sensor
products.shortDescription: Transmitted-light measurement provides water transparency and temperature readings without chemical reagents. A compact digital probe with an automatic cleaning brush supports online monitoring in surface waters, river channels and aquaculture, helping limit deposits on the optical surface.

products.name: IG3254COD UV COD and TOC Sensor
products.shortDescription: Ultraviolet absorption supports online COD and TOC measurement without reagent dosing. Turbidity compensation, calibration options and an available automatic cleaning system help adapt the digital probe to water monitoring, with results interpreted according to the selected calibration.

products.name: IG3500 Residual Chlorine Analyzer
products.shortDescription: DPD colorimetry measures residual chlorine in water for supply and process monitoring. The analyzer combines optical interference compensation, automatic cleaning and data storage, with relay outputs for control integration and an optional remote communication module for connected operation.

products.name: IG3500AN Ammonia Nitrogen Analyzer
products.shortDescription: Salicylate spectrophotometry measures ammonia nitrogen in water. Automatic range selection, quality-control routines and operating logs support online monitoring, with alarm functions and electrical communication interfaces for integration into drinking water, environmental and wastewater monitoring systems.

products.name: IG3500CODmn Permanganate Index Analyzer
products.shortDescription: Permanganate oxidation and titration determine the permanganate index in water. Automatic range switching, quality-control checks and operating logs support online monitoring, while alarm functions and standard electrical interfaces help connect the analyzer to a wider monitoring system.

products.name: IG3500TN Total Nitrogen Analyzer
products.shortDescription: Alkaline persulfate digestion followed by ultraviolet spectrophotometry determines total nitrogen in water. Automatic range switching, quality-control checks and measurement logs support online operation, with communication and alarm functions for integration into environmental and wastewater monitoring systems.

products.name: IG3500TP Total Phosphorus Analyzer
products.shortDescription: Sample digestion and ammonium molybdate spectrophotometry determine total phosphorus in water. Automatic range switching, quality-control routines and measurement logs support online operation, with communication interfaces and alarm functions for environmental, drinking water and wastewater monitoring applications.

products.name: IG9000 Ultrasonic Level Transmitter
products.shortDescription: Ultrasonic time-of-flight measurement monitors levels in liquids and bulk materials without contact with the medium. Integrated and separate arrangements, signal analysis and temperature compensation support installation in water treatment and storage tanks, with configuration options matched to the measurement point.

content.heading: Surface water
content.bodyHtml: Whether in the form of monitoring stations or mobile laboratories (fixed or mobile stations), IGENU plays a role in the protection of surface water, spring water, rivers and groundwater. The aim is to obtain real-time measures of surface water pollution, in order to, if necessary, protect drinking water at its source.
